summary: Test suite is well-structured with clear organization (unit tests per module, integration tests in separate directory) and demonstrates solid understanding of TDD and act-based testing. However, it is fundamentally incomplete: critical fixture files (fixtures/*/VERSION, fixtures/*/commits.log) and the GitHub Actions workflow file (.github/workflows/semantic-version-bumper.yml) that the integration tests depend on are not provided. Unit test coverage of core logic is good (semver parsing, commit parsing, changelog generation, bumper orchestration, error handling), but lacks edge cases (version numbers with leading zeros, extreme values, BREAKING-CHANGE with hyphen variant, file permission errors, changelog prepending to existing files). Integration test via act is well-designed but only covers 3 scenarios, and contains an inconsistency: workflow-structure.test.ts checks for a 'fix-patch' fixture that act.test.ts never runs. Without the missing fixture files and workflow file, these tests cannot execute at all; with them, rigor would improve to 4 with more edge cases added.
